reviews_h2: What people are saying about the landscaping

reviews.author: Edward Janda
reviews.text: Very prompt and professional. We had a very large and mature double trunk Silver Maple between 2 houses and a tight space to work. We called and they came out that day. We agreed to use them and scheduled an appointment for removal a few days later. They showed up right on time got to work and worked throughout the day to get the job finished. Miro was skilled and you could tell he was taking his time with his cuts and rigging so that no damage was done . The crew worked well together and when they were finished, came back the next day to tidy up and load the wood.

reviews.author: Robin Birth
reviews.text: They damaged my trees while trimming my tree, that they didn't have permission to trim. They also placed ladders on my property without permission, because they thought the neighbor who hired them had asked permission. Do yourself a favor and hire a real tree service if you need your trees trimmed.

reviews.author: Stephanie Marie
reviews.text: I called in the morning and they were able to cut my grass only in the afternoon. Very professional and fast on what they do. They have a good price on cutting grass only and discuss an agreement for continuing services for a reasonable price. They speak English and Spanish which I love.

reviews.author: Adam Sciarillo
reviews.text: Great Land Scapers is always on time very professional always very clean. The landscaping at my house looks beautiful do you to them. They are very reasonable on price. I do recommend them M..

reviews.author: NVP Patel
reviews.text: The edging and mulching work that you did around the island looks amazing. Excellent service and prices very reasonable for all the services. ( lawn cut, mulching etc. ) Miro, I'll be sure to recommend you in the future.

reviews.author: Frank Vanaman
reviews.text: Armiragaro is the best! He and his crew do an awesome job... great service, great prices! Definitely recommend... and i have.

reviews.author: Chris Dabney
reviews.text: Love this company. They’ve been taking care of my properties for years. Always reliable. Can’t say enough good things. Definitely go with them.

reviews.author: Marla T
reviews.text: If I could rate a no star, then that is what I would do. The "job" that was done next door to me looks like it was done by little kids with no professional supervision. A very poor job. I know that I would never ever hire them, let alone call them landscapers!

reviews.author: Katiria R
reviews.text: Very pleased with the work. The grass came out really nice. They were quick and the price was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Los Martin
reviews.text: This guys rock. He asked me about my needs and how quickly I wanted. explained my needs and he offered my a great quote. It was great and the job, excellent!!! Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Edward Faulcon
reviews.text: Star has done several jobs for me, tree work, project work, stones, bushes, trimming. I couldn't have been happier with their work and look forward to working with them again.
